text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to replace a portion of the existing "No Parking, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday to Friday" regulation on the north side of Norby Crescent, along the frontage of Father Serra School with a "Maximum 10 Minute, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday to Friday" regulation. In addition, to implement a "Maximum 10 Minute, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday to Friday" regulation on the east side of Sun Row Drive from a point 122 metres north of Norby Crescent and a point 32 metres further north. These amendments will address the need for additional drop-off and pick-up space for parents of attending school children. The proposed parking amendment is the result of consultation with the Local Councillor and principal of the school.
Etobicoke York Community Council received this Item for information.
